ColonyCouncil.GroupHabitDef.label: an hour with a book
ColonyCouncil.GroupHabitDef.description: They read in the same room of an evening, and now and then one reads a line aloud to the rest.

ColonyCouncil.GroupHabitDef.label: keeping the sick company
ColonyCouncil.GroupHabitDef.description: When one of them is laid up, ill or hurt, the others come and sit by the bed.

ColonyCouncil.GroupHabitDef.label: music of an evening
ColonyCouncil.GroupHabitDef.description: One of them plays, and the rest listen, hum along, or try to sing.

ColonyCouncil.GroupHabitDef.label: the night sky
ColonyCouncil.GroupHabitDef.description: Of a night they go out under the open sky together and name what they see up there.

ColonyCouncil.GroupShareDef.label: reading
ColonyCouncil.GroupShareDef.why: They are friends, and read together of an evening.

ColonyCouncil.GroupShareDef.label: the sickbed
ColonyCouncil.GroupShareDef.why: They are friends, and keep each other company when one of them is laid up.

ColonyCouncil.GroupShareDef.label: music
ColonyCouncil.GroupShareDef.why: They are friends, and make music together of an evening.

ColonyCouncil.GroupShareDef.label: the night sky
ColonyCouncil.GroupShareDef.why: They are friends, and go out under the night sky together.

ColonyCouncil.GroupShareDef.label: the cells
ColonyCouncil.GroupShareDef.why: They are friends, and most of them keep the prisoners.

ColonyCouncil.GroupKindDef.label: wardens
ColonyCouncil.GroupKindDef.why: They keep the colony's prisoners, and talk about little else.

plain.li: Listen to this bit.
I've read this page three times now.
Don't tell me how it ends.
This one's better than the last one.
Who folded the corner of my page?
I'll swap you when I'm done.
Quiet, I'm at the good part.
Have you got to the bit with the river yet?
[lowtech] Move the candle a little closer, would you?
[!lowtech] Turn the light up a little, would you?
[winter] Good weather for a book, this.
[rain] Rain on the roof and a book, that's all I want.
[child] Can you read me the next page?
[grouprole:anchor] Same time tomorrow, then.
[grouprole:joker] I only read for the pictures.
[grouprole:quiet] Mm.
[grouprole:newcomer] Is there a book I could borrow?
[grouprole:worrier] I shouldn't have started a sad one before bed.
[groupkind:scholars] This disagrees with everything we found last week.
[groupkind:elders] My eyes aren't what they were, so read it out for me.

warm.li: I'm glad of the company, even a quiet one.
Read me the end again, I liked it.

cheerful.li: I've finished another one, that's four this season.
This one made me laugh out loud.

gloomy.li: I can't keep my eyes open.

cold.li: The writer is wrong about nearly everything.
This is the one quiet hour I get.

plain.li: How are you feeling today?
I brought you some water.
Don't try to sit up.
You look better than you did yesterday.
The healer says another day or two.
We've kept your seat for you.
Shall I tell you what you've missed?
Is it hurting much?
Try to sleep a little, I'll stay.
[lowtech] I've brought you broth, and it's still warm.
[!lowtech] I brought you something to read.
[child] Are you going to be all right?
[grouprole:joker] You'll do anything to get out of the hauling.
[grouprole:anchor] We're all here, so rest easy.
[grouprole:worrier] Are you sure you're warm enough?
[grouprole:quiet] I'll just sit.
[grouprole:peacemaker] Nobody minds about the work, just get well.
[groupkind:healers] Let me look at that dressing while I'm here.
[groupkind:comrades] You've had worse than this, I've seen you.

warm.li: Get well, that's all we want.

cheerful.li: You've got the best bed in the place, lucky you.
I've saved up all the gossip for you.

gloomy.li: You gave us all a fright.
This place makes everyone sick sooner or later.

cold.li: You'll be back at work soon enough.

plain.li: Play the one about the river.
Again, from the start.
That's a good tune.
I don't know the words, but I'll hum.
Slower, I can't keep up.
Who taught you that one?
Play something we can sing to.
One more, then bed.
[lowtech] My mother sang that one at harvest.
[winter] Play something warm.
[child] Can I have a go?
[grouprole:joker] I'm going to sing, and you've all been warned.
[grouprole:anchor] Good, now everyone sit down.
[grouprole:quiet] Lovely.
[grouprole:newcomer] Do you play every evening?
[groupkind:artists] You came in a beat early there.
[groupkind:young] Play something fast.
[groupnorm:merry] Up, everyone, we're dancing.

warm.li: That one always makes me think of home.
I could listen to you all night.

cheerful.li: I'm dancing whether you like it or not.
That's my favorite, play it twice.

gloomy.li: Play the sad one, it suits the day.
That tune makes me miss people.

plain.li: There, that bright one, see it?
It's a clear night for it.
I always look for the same three stars.
Do you think anyone's looking back at us?
That one moved, I swear it did.
Lie back, you see more that way.
My neck's stiff from looking up.
Look how many there are tonight.
[lowtech] My grandmother had a name for every one of those.
[spacer] One of those is the sun I was born under.
[winter] Cold out here, but worth it.
[child] How far away are they?
[grouprole:joker] I've named that one after the cook's stew.
[grouprole:anchor] Let's come out again tomorrow if it's clear.
[grouprole:quiet] Look at that.
[grouprole:worrier] We should get back in before it gets any colder.
[groupkind:elders] They were brighter when I was young.
[groupkind:offworlders] I can't tell which one was home any more.
[groupkind:tribeborn] The old ones read the seasons in those.
[groupkind:nightshift] Best part of the night shift, this.

warm.li: It makes everything down here seem small, in a good way.

cheerful.li: I'm going to count them all, give me a minute.

gloomy.li: They'll still be up there long after we're gone.

cold.li: That light is older than this colony.
